description: Decision returned by the proactive-conversation skill. Kept to features supported by common structured-output engines; range and SPEAK/WAIT consistency rules are enforced by scripts/validate.py: confidence in [0,1]; message is null for WAIT and a non-empty string for SPEAK; SPEAK requires at least one evidence id and confidence >= 0.6.

decision.description: SPEAK = initiate a conversation now; WAIT = stay silent.

reason.description: One or two sentences: the opportunity (or its absence) and the deciding factor.

message.description: Opening message for SPEAK; null for WAIT.

confidence.description: Probability (0-1) that this decision is the right one.

evidence.description: Ids of history messages, events, or memories that justify the decision.
